Counter overlays improve event economics; same-side fixed add and delayed-same mechanics are negative. Counter-switch tail improves at event level but crystallizes losses too early for $100 capital.
Reject switch-as-rescue for seed capital; realizing the primary adverse loss before recovery destroys rolling-start survivability.
